instruction: Implement and verify CNET model compression Phase 5: Improvement Engine Integration.
response: Implemented Improvement Engine Integration for CNET model compression. Replaced the temporary Phase 5 bridge with a self-contained C improvement-engine bridge that exports CNET compression implementation logs into registry-ready suggestions and instruction/response training data, plus a C regression test for idempotent export. Artifacts: tools/register_compression_improvements.c, tests/phase5_integration_test.c, docs/improvement_engine_integration.md, plans/phase5_improvement_engine_integration.md, suggestions/cnet_compression_suggestions.jsonl, training_data.jsonl. Remaining work: wire external suggestion registry when available locally; wire external perpetual improvement engine when available locally; copy reusable implementation pattern into Self-Development-Log.md during the next self-development cycle.
